translated_pages.text:
Propiedades Los Robles LLC
Arlington, Virginia
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Tenant: SAMPLE INQUILINO
Home: Apartment 5, Los Robles Building, Arlington, Virginia
Term: from December 1, 2026 to November 30, 2027.
Monthly rent: $1,650.00, paid on the 1st of each month.
Late fee: $75.00 if rent is paid after the 5th of the month.
Security deposit: $1,650.00, returned according to the law when the lease ends.
Notice to vacate: the tenant must give written notice 60 days before the lease ends.
Automatic renewal: if no one gives notice, the lease continues month to month.
Office phone: (703) 555-0190
Tenant signature: ____________ Landlord signature: ____________

summary_title: Lease in Spanish from Propiedades Los Robles LLC
summary_body: This is a lease for Apartment 5 in Arlington, Virginia. It runs from December 1, 2026 to November 30, 2027. Rent is $1,650.00 each month. The paper is written in Spanish.
summary_body_en: This is a lease for Apartment 5 in Arlington, Virginia. It runs from December 1, 2026 to November 30, 2027. Rent is $1,650.00 each month. The paper is written in Spanish.

demands.text: The lease starts on December 1, 2026 (printed as "1 de diciembre de 2026").
demands.source_quote: Plazo: del 1 de diciembre de 2026 al 30 de noviembre de 2027.

demands.text: The lease ends on November 30, 2027 (printed as "30 de noviembre de 2027").
demands.source_quote: Plazo: del 1 de diciembre de 2026 al 30 de noviembre de 2027.

demands.text: Rent is $1,650.00 each month, paid on the 1st.
demands.source_quote: Renta mensual: $1,650.00, que se paga el día 1 de cada mes.
demands.ambiguity_note: This is monthly rent. There is no single due date.

demands.text: To end the lease, the tenant must give written notice 60 days before the end, the lease says.
demands.value_verbatim: 60 días antes de terminar el contrato
demands.source_quote: Aviso para desocupar: el inquilino debe avisar por escrito 60 días antes de terminar el contrato.

plan_steps.text: Keep a copy of the lease with both signatures.
Ask the landlord about any rule you do not understand, like the late fee or the renewal rule.
A housing counselor can read the lease with you.

glossary.explanation: Security deposit: money you pay at the start. It can come back when you move out.
Late fee: extra money if rent is paid late.
Automatic renewal: the lease keeps going unless someone gives notice.
Notice to move out: telling the landlord in writing that you will leave.

questions_to_ask: Can I get a copy of this lease in English?
When does the security deposit come back?
How do I give written notice?
clerk_need_en: a lease - the rent, the dates and the rules in it
